research_findings: Discovered that the React client-side filtering via Fuse.js in `ProblemExplorer.tsx` was directly hooked to the input state, potentially blocking the UI thread on rapid keystrokes.
Identified a 'time-bomb' test in `launch-offer-grant.test.ts` that failed due to a hardcoded campaign deadline passing, instead of mocking the time/campaign status.
features_improved: Optimized client-side fuzzy search in `ProblemExplorer.tsx` by wrapping the immediate search state in `useDeferredValue`, unblocking the UI thread.
Fixed flaky/time-dependent test in `launch-offer-grant.test.ts` by explicitly mocking `isLaunchOfferActive`.
next_steps_for_next_run: Review other heavy client-side filtering components for similar `useDeferredValue` optimizations.
Identify and refactor any other time-dependent tests to ensure deterministic execution regardless of the current date.
Analyze bundle size and consider dynamically importing `fuse.js` only when the user interacts with the search input.
